scope: Bounded official evidence for recurrent Rio La Leche flooding and high-flow impacts in Pacora and Pitipo. This asset does not close the Rio Motupe component, local ravines, current hydraulic capacity, or the compound Phase-2 zone contract.

official_hydrologic_identity.interpretation: ANA classifies Rio La Leche inside hydrologic unit 137772. The whole-unit identity is basin context and is not an event inundation footprint, local impact polygon, or proof of event-specific routing.

sources.institution: Gobierno Regional de Lambayeque / Proyecto Especial Olmos Tinajones

historical_positive_outcomes.outcome: INDECI reports intense rainfall increased Rio La Leche and inundated Pacora settlements, with 325 people affected as disaster victims and 65 dwellings destroyed.
The SENAMHI national flood inventory records rupture/overflow of Rio La Leche at Pacora with 30 affected families, 30 uninhabitable dwellings and 150 disaster victims.

The regional government reports increased Rio La Leche flow and overflow that destroyed multiple water intakes and affected agricultural land and crops; emergency works targeted vulnerable reaches including San Isidro-Pacora, Luren, Las Juntas and La Cirila.
COEN-INDECI reports intense rainfall caused increased Rio La Leche flow and subsequent overflow, damaging dwellings in the San Luis settlement of Pitipo.

supporting_context.note: Official regional material documents Rio La Leche overflow during March 2017 and damaged dwellings near Bocatoma San Isidro; exact event-day pairing is not asserted here.

COEN-INDECI reports intense rainfall increased Rio La Leche flow and transported rock/wood, causing collapse of a pedestrian bridge at Tres Puentes B. This supports high-flow response context but is not labeled as a flood-overflow control.

current_exposure_and_mitigation_context.project_scope: Flood-protection project for 53 localities in Pacora, Illimo, Jayanca, Pitipo and Incahuasi.

negative_control_status.rule: Absence of reported damage is never interpreted as a hydrologic negative without independent rainfall/river-state and outcome adjudication.

scientific_limits: No event-day rainfall or discharge series is paired to the 1998, 2015 or 2025 positive outcomes in this evidence asset.
The official ANA hydrologic-unit identity is not an observed inundation footprint and no machine-readable basin geometry is normalized here.
The bounded closeout is for the Rio La Leche Pacora-Pitipo component only; Rio Motupe, local ravines and the full compound candidate remain unresolved.
Current protection-project scope is not backcast as historical exposure or historical hydraulic capacity.
No provider alert band, design discharge or project design value is promoted to an IRFEN operational threshold.
No negative control is fabricated from missing reports or non-impact wording.
forbidden_uses: negative-control inference from absence of reports
treating whole-basin identity as event footprint
closing or activating the Rio Motupe or full compound system
